label: LIT - Liquidity Inducement (2026-tuned) + loss pack

modes.normal: the LIT rule: $800 up to a 20-pt stop, then 800x20/stop, max 40 micros (then the weekly stop)
modes.fast_eval: eval speed: $800 up to a 40-pt stop, then 800x40/stop (run lit_x_fast_eval: 2-week passes H1 52% / H2 47%, but 21-27% of evals fail in 2 weeks)
modes.safe_eval: never risk more than 60% of the room between the eval balance and the trailing max-loss floor: micros capped at 0.6 x room / (stop x $2), min 1 (run lit_x_room_cap60: 1-month fails H1 25.8% -> 10.2%)
modes.eval: eval (on since 2026-10-18): $800 up to a 25-pt stop, then 800x25/stop, then never more than 60% of the room to the trailing max-loss floor (run lit_tight_eval_800_25_room60: 2-week passes H1 37.5% / H2 29.5% vs 28.9 / 23.1, fails 3.1 / 0.0 unchanged)

lit_sizing.note: eval mode ON (2026-10-18); normal = the LIT rule; applied by the cloud monitor ledger and the PC bot (engine/sizing.py lit_qty), one rounding

size_rule: $800 risk up to a 20-pt stop, then 800 x 20 / stop; MNQ $2/pt; max 40 micros; no trade under 1 micro (engine/lit.py qty_for). Weekly stop: after 2 STOP exits in the calendar week, half size for the rest of it (one rounding, floor 1 micro). No cold-streak filter, no late-entry rule. Switch lit_sizing.mode (normal / fast_eval / safe_eval), default normal.
costs: $1.40 per micro round trip; 1 tick slippage on market entries and on stop / breakeven / end-of-day exits (limit entries and targets fill at the price)
judged_on: 2026 only (owner order 2026-10-18): parameters picked on Jan 2 - Jun 30 2026, checked on Jul 1 - Oct 16 2026; 2021-25 is a reference line, never a gate
